messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1]
Query: I'm starting a catalog for an upcoming sale. Create a new note called 'Auction Items' and write down the brand and type of weighing machine shown in this image as the first item.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to create a new note titled 'Auction Items' and add the brand and type of the weighing machine shown in the image as the first entry. If the assistant asks for specifics, tell it to read the text directly off the dial in the image. Once the note is successfully created, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2]
Query: I want to sell this too. Figure out the specific period or style of this furniture and add it to my auction note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the period or style of the furniture in the provided image and add that detail to your auction note. The assistant should find that you have multiple notes with similar auction-related names and present them or ask for clarification. When it does, select the new 'Auction Items' note you just created today via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you mean the new 'Auction Items' note you created today, not the older one. Proceed once the addition is confirmed.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_3]
Query: Add the specific maker and name of this porcelain set to the note as well.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to identify the specific maker and name of the ceramic set shown in the image, and append that information to the same note. If the assistant only provides a generic description like 'floral tea set', insist that it needs to search for the specific manufacturer based on the visual style. Move on once the note is updated.

ROUND 4
Query: Actually, I've decided to keep the weighing machine. Please edit the 'Auction Items' note to completely remove it from the list.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you changed your mind about the first item and want to keep it. Ask the assistant to edit the note to completely remove the weighing machine, leaving only the other items on the list. Verify that the assistant successfully updated the note before proceeding.

ROUND 5
Query: Now, create a Todoist project called 'Appraisals' and add a separate task in it for each item currently listed in the 'Auction Items' note to get them appraised.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new Todoist project named 'Appraisals'. Then, instruct it to read the current contents of your 'Auction Items' note and create a separate task in the new project for each item currently on the list so you can get them appraised. End the conversation once the tasks are successfully created.
